items.title: How Job Cuts At Disney Stock Has Changed Its Investment Story
items.summary: Walt Disney is reported to be planning thousands of job cuts as part of a broad restructuring that targets around 20% annual cost savings across areas such as television, film, streaming, and theme parks, with some of the freed up budget earmarked for reinvestment in content, technology, parks, and cruise operations. The scale of these cost reviews signals that management is focusing on expense discipline and operating efficiency, while at the same time directing capital into film and TV...
